faqHome.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our services and processes.

timeline.question: How long does it take to set up a business in the UAE?
timeline.answer: Timelines vary by jurisdiction and business activity. Many free zone company formations can move quickly once documents are in order, while mainland setups or activities needing extra approvals can take longer. We'll give you a specific timeline once we understand your requirements.

mainland-vs-freezone.question: What is the difference between Mainland and Free Zone?
mainland-vs-freezone.answer: A mainland company can trade freely across the UAE and take on government contracts. A free zone company is registered within a specific zone, often with 100% foreign ownership and a streamlined setup, but may have restrictions on trading directly in the local mainland market.

remote-setup.question: Do I need to be in the UAE to start a company?
remote-setup.answer: Not necessarily. Many free zone and offshore company formations can be completed remotely with the right documentation and power of attorney arrangements. Some steps, such as opening a bank account or visa processing, may require your presence in the UAE at some stage.

bank-account.question: Can you help with bank account opening?
bank-account.answer: Yes — we support clients through the corporate bank account opening process, including preparing documentation and guiding you through each bank's requirements. Final approval always rests with the bank.

documents.question: What documents are required for company formation?
documents.answer: Requirements vary by jurisdiction and activity, but typically include passport copies, proof of address, and a description of your business activity. We'll provide an exact checklist once we know your chosen setup.

setup-cost.question: How much does it cost to start a business in Dubai?
setup-cost.answer: Setup costs depend on your jurisdiction (mainland vs. free zone), license type, business activity, number of visas, and whether you need physical office space. Free zone packages often carry a lower starting cost than an equivalent mainland setup. We'll prepare a detailed, itemized quote once we understand your requirements — final costs are always confirmed with you before you commit to anything.

foreign-ownership.question: Can foreigners own 100% of a UAE company?
foreign-ownership.answer: In most cases, yes. UAE free zones have always allowed 100% foreign ownership, and UAE mainland company law now permits full foreign ownership for the large majority of commercial and industrial activities, with a limited list of activities still subject to additional requirements. We'll confirm the ownership rules that apply to your specific activity and jurisdiction.

office-requirement.question: Do I need an office to set up a business in the UAE?
office-requirement.answer: It depends on your jurisdiction and license type. Many free zones offer flexi-desk or virtual office options that satisfy setup requirements without a dedicated physical space, while mainland licenses and certain activities typically require a physical tenancy contract. We'll advise on the office solution that fits your license type and budget.

visa-quota.question: How many visas can I obtain for my company?
visa-quota.answer: Visa allocation is generally tied to your office space (or flexi-desk package) and jurisdiction, with each free zone and the mainland authority applying their own quota rules — some setups allow just a few visas, others considerably more with larger office space. We'll confirm the exact visa allocation for the setup you choose.

local-partner.question: Do I need a local partner or sponsor?
local-partner.answer: For free zone company formation and most mainland commercial and industrial activities, no — 100% foreign ownership is permitted. A local service agent (not an equity partner) may still be required for certain licenses, and a small list of activities with strategic significance retain local ownership requirements. We'll confirm what applies to your specific activity.

tax-obligations.question: What are my tax obligations as a UAE business?
tax-obligations.answer: UAE businesses are generally subject to corporate tax on profits above the exempt threshold, with reduced or 0% rates available on qualifying income for qualifying free zone entities, plus VAT once registration thresholds are met. Exact obligations depend on your activity, jurisdiction, and revenue, so we'll assess your specific position and handle registration and ongoing filing.

golden-visa.question: Am I eligible for the UAE Golden Visa?
golden-visa.answer: The Golden Visa is a long-term UAE residency (typically 10 years) available to eligible investors, entrepreneurs, and specialized talent, each category with its own criteria — for example a minimum investment amount, business valuation, or professional qualification. We'll review your profile against the current criteria and guide you through the nomination and documentation process.

which-free-zone.question: Which UAE free zone should I set up in?
which-free-zone.answer: The right free zone depends on your business activity, target market, budget, and whether you need physical office space or specific facilities. We work across every UAE free zone, so we compare the options relevant to your business and recommend the one that fits best rather than a one-size-fits-all answer.

aml-compliance.question: Do I need AML compliance for my UAE business?
aml-compliance.answer: Certain business activities designated as Anti-Money Laundering (AML) "relevant persons" under UAE law — such as real estate brokers, dealers in precious metals and stones, and certain corporate service providers — have specific AML/CFT obligations, including registration on the goAML platform and UBO declarations. We'll confirm whether your activity is in scope and assist with setting up the required policies and registrations.

careers.question: How do I apply for a job at Nexus Zone?
careers.answer: Visit our Careers page to see any current openings, or submit a speculative application with your CV if nothing listed matches your background right now. Our team reviews every application and will reach out if there's a fit.
